'''Chapter 1093''' is titled "Luffy vs. Kizaru".

==Cover Page==
[[Cover Page]] Request: "Tarsier brothers stealing [[Koby]] and [[Helmeppo]]'s eyewear." by PN Black Beans.

==Short Summary==
As [[Monkey D. Luffy|Luffy]] knocks [[Borsalino|Kizaru]] away, [[Vegapunk/Atlas|Atlas]] heads out to regain control of the [[Pacifista#Mark III|Pacifista Mark III]] with [[Vegapunk]] deciding to go to check on [[Jewelry Bonney|Bonney]], along with [[Franky]] and [[Sanji]]. Kizaru returns and tries to eliminate Vegapunk, but Luffy takes the hit. Vegapunk's group succeeds in reaching their destination, as Atlas issues the Pacifista their new orders to eliminate the [[Marines]].

==Long Summary==
[[Monkey D. Luffy|Luffy]] swings [[Borsalino|Kizaru]] around and eventually throws him far away from the Control Tower, giving everyone a window of opportunity to escape. [[Vegapunk/Atlas|Atlas]] decides to head for the [[Egghead#Fabiriophase|Fabiriophase]] to steal back control of the [[Pacifista|Pacifista Mark III]], knowing that they will be a hindrance to their escape. [[Vegapunk|Dr. Vegapunk]] decides to join Atlas and he contacts [[Franky]] to inform him that [[Jewelry Bonney|Bonney]] is still alive but on the Fabiriophase. [[Sanji]] offers to join the two to find her while [[Jinbe]] gathers Dr. Vegapunk’s luggage, telling everyone to meet up at the back exit.

On the Fabiriophase, the [[Marines]] start looking for Bonney, who is using her [[Devil Fruit]] powers to incapacitate several Marines by [[Toshi Toshi no Mi|changing]] their age. As she hides, she looks at the unconscious [[Sentomaru]], remembering how he caught her after she hit the [[Egghead#Frontier Dome|Frontier Dome’s]] barrier and fell before passing out again. Meanwhile, Luffy sees [[Roronoa Zoro|Zoro]] in his King of Hell state fighting [[Rob Lucci|Lucci]], with the former reminding his captain to keep focusing on Kizaru. After trading a few blows, Zoro tells Lucci that with his level of power, he will not let him face Luffy. In response, Lucci says he would be better off killing Zoro since he is practically Luffy’s “No. 2”.

As for Kizaru, he manages to avoid falling into the sea and uses '''[[Pika Pika no Mi#Techniques|Yasakani no Magatama]]''' to return to the island at lightspeed. Once he catches up to Luffy, he turns the individual light particles into copies of himself, all of which use '''Ama no Murakumo''' to create light swords to attack him, though they surprisingly do minor damage to Luffy. He responds to Kizaru’s attack by using '''Gomu Gomu no Dawn Whip''' to destroy a few, before making a run for it. As the copies chase after him, Luffy reveals that he was getting them lined up to take them all out at once with '''[[Gomu Gomu no Mi/Gear 5 Techniques#Techniques|Gomu Gomu no Dawn Stamp]]'''. Much to his misfortune, he realizes that Kizaru used those copies to distract Luffy long enough to return to the Control Tower, where he grabs [[Usopp]].

Kizaru realizes that Dr. Vegapunk is no longer present, and both he and Luffy see him and Atlas riding a contraption called Vegatank-08, with Sanji hanging on the outside. Dr. Vegapunk declares that he is on his way to save Bonney. Kizaru tries to blast him, but Luffy takes the shot. Franky joins the three as he tells [[Vegapunk/Lilith|Lilith]] to use [[Battle Frankies/General Franky|General Franky]] to carry the [[Thousand Sunny]].

On the coast, the Marines are informed that Dr. Vegapunk has left the Labophase. [[Vegapunk/Edison|Edison]] partially disables the Frontier Dome, allowing Dr. Vegapunk to exit safely, and Atlas issues a new command to the Pacifista to annihilate all the Marines on the island.

==Quick References==
===Chapter Notes===
*[[Monkey D. Luffy|Luffy]] launches [[Borsalino|Kizaru]] towards the ocean, but the latter manages to recover and return to [[Egghead]] before hitting the seawater.
**Kizaru tries to blast [[Vegapunk]] with a laser but Luffy intercepts the attack.
*[[Roronoa Zoro|Zoro]] continues his battle against [[Rob Lucci|Lucci]].
*[[Sentomaru]] saved [[Jewelry Bonney|Bonney]] from her fall off the Labophase, but collapsed afterwards.
*Dr. Vegapunk and [[Vegapunk/Atlas|Atlas]] head to the Fabiriophase in their Vegatank-08.
**[[Sanji]] and [[Franky]] accompany them.
***Franky has [[Vegapunk/Lilith|Lilith]] use the [[Battle Frankies/General Franky|General Franky]] to move the [[Thousand Sunny]].
**Atlas manages to issue new orders to the [[Pacifista|Pacifista Mark III]].
